tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The whole product sits on warm paper, never pure white.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs and anything that must lift off `paper`: text fields, checkbox faces, the media well of an IssueCard.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body copy, frame borders and illustration line work. Reads on `paper`, `paper-raised`, `sage-100` and every status tint in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: feature descriptions, card meta (location · time), hints, captions. Reads on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `sage-100`.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: section dividers and the short caption rules under a frame. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of text fields and checkboxes, 3:1 on `paper` and `paper-raised` so the control is findable.

tokens.name: sage-100
tokens.usage: The callout band behind a CalloutBand; the one large tinted surface on a page.

tokens.name: sage-200
tokens.usage: Fill of the `resolved` status badge and the done dots of a StatusTimeline.

tokens.name: sage-300
tokens.usage: Illustration accent and the brand's signature green in art; not for text.

tokens.name: green-600
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and links on hover. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `green-600`.

tokens.name: yellow-200
tokens.usage: Fill of the `reported` status badge; highlight wash behind a key word in art.

tokens.name: yellow-400
tokens.usage: Illustration accent (the highlighter yellow); not for text.

tokens.name: blue-200
tokens.usage: Fill of the `in-progress` status badge.

tokens.name: blue-500
tokens.usage: Illustration accent (sky, water, devices); not for text.

tokens.name: rose-200
tokens.usage: Fill of the `urgent` status badge: hazards to people (exposed wiring, open manholes).

tokens.name: rose-500
tokens.usage: Illustration accent; not for text.

tokens.name: stone-200
tokens.usage: Fill of the `reviewing` and `closed` status badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and the error border of a TextField. Always paired with a written message. Reads on `paper` and `paper-raised`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px solid focus ring on every interactive element, offset 2px; 3:1 on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `sage-100`.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: A weekly digest of what your street needs
styles.usage: Hero headline, once per page, centred. Italicise one or two words with <em>.

styles.name: display-em
styles.usage: The italic accent words inside `display`; never a whole line.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Be the first-in on your neighbourhood
styles.usage: Section headings and the CalloutBand heading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tell us what you saw and where. We'll route it to the right department.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Get alerts when a report near you changes status.
styles.usage: Feature descriptions, card meta, CalloutBand body.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: By subscribing you agree to the Privacy Policy
styles.usage: Consent lines, timestamps, legal. Never smaller.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a field and its button; title to meta.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap under a frame before its caption; form row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding, label to input.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card internal padding; gutter between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between feature columns.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Padding inside the CalloutBand.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between a section heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between page sections. Generous air is the brand.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Frames, cards, bands: everything drawn like a picture frame is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges only.

stroke.note: Line weights. The system separates with lines, not shadows.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: `rule` dividers, control borders.

tokens.name: stroke-frame
tokens.usage: The `ink` frame around an IssueCard's media and illustrations.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width.
